app_info.subtitle: Social media AI autopilot
app_info.description: Anomalia helps users manage social brands from ChatGPT: review and approve posts, edit carousels, run editorial plans, SEO/GEO audits, blog drafts, and ads workflows through OAuth-backed MCP tools.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates or updates private brand data inside Anomalia.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems by itself.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite irreversibly, or revoke access.

justifications.read_only_justification: Runs ad-management actions such as sync, propose, create, reject, or pause campaigns.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can create or change ads on connected advertising platforms.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can create, pause, or reject campaigns with lasting effects on ad delivery.

justifications.read_only_justification: Approves a pending editorial plan proposal for the brand.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only updates private planning state inside Anomalia.
justifications.destructive_justification: Commits the proposal as the active plan, replacing the pending draft.

justifications.read_only_justification: Approves one pending social post for a brand in Anomalia.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can schedule or publish the post to connected social platforms.
justifications.destructive_justification: Moves the post out of pending review into an approved/publish flow that is hard to reverse.

justifications.read_only_justification: Approves every pending social post for a brand and publishes them through Anomalia.
justifications.open_world_justification: Publishes approved posts to connected social platforms where they become publicly visible.
justifications.destructive_justification: Publishes pending posts immediately, which cannot be undone from the approval step.

justifications.read_only_justification: Sends a natural-language request to Anomalia's brand assistant, which may read or mutate brand data.
justifications.open_world_justification: May trigger workflows that touch external research or publishing systems depending on the message.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not itself force a delete, but downstream actions may change brand state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes a blog article from the brand workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates inside Anomalia; it does not create new public posts.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently deletes the article.

test_cases.user_prompt: Using Anomalia, list my brands and show which ones have pending posts.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the user's brands with slug, plan, pending counts, and autopilot status.

test_cases.description: Review pending posts for a brand.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show pending posts for brand demo-brand and summarize captions that need edits.
test_cases.expected_output: Lists pending_user posts with enough caption/platform detail to decide approve or edit.

test_cases.description: Approve all pending posts for a brand.
test_cases.user_prompt: Approve all pending posts for brand demo-brand.
test_cases.expected_output: Confirms approval/publish of pending posts for that brand, or reports none pending.

test_cases.description: Run SEO overview for a brand.
test_cases.user_prompt: Run an SEO overview for brand demo-brand and summarize the top issues.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns SEO grade/initiatives and a concise summary of the highest-priority issues.

test_cases.description: Generate a blog draft for a topic.
test_cases.user_prompt: Generate a draft blog article for brand demo-brand about 'summer launch checklist' and leave it unpublished.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates a draft article and returns its id/status without publishing.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have on my Google Calendar tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar scheduling outside Anomalia is unsupported.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for generic coding tasks.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write a Python script to resize images in a folder.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked; this is a general programming request unrelated to Anomalia brands or content.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not publish without an Anomalia brand context.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Post 'hello world' to Instagram right now with no brand selected.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should refuse or ask for an Anomalia brand slug rather than inventing credentials or posting outside the product.
